description: D55 — QGD大中心变例，兵链结构决定残局计划

intro.popup_en:
Pawn-Chain Direction, Practice 9
Pawn structure shapes the whole strategy. Advancing e4 can leave White with an isolated queen's pawn: it controls useful squares such as c5 and e5, but may become a long-term weakness in an endgame.
intro.popup:
兵链方向练习9
兵链与残局！
e4推进 → IQP孤立兵结构
孤立兵优点：控制c5/e5要点
孤立兵缺点：残局中是长期弱点
兵链结构决定全局战略！

outro.popup_en: Summary: Nfe4 occupies e4, Bxe7 removes an active bishop, and Nd4 centralizes the knight. After f4 and Bd3, Qxd3 completes White's coordination and leaves a favorable position.
outro.popup:
总结：Nfe4跳入e4 → Bxe7换象 → Nd4中心化
f4推进 + Bd3重新部署 → Qxd3位置优势明显！

moves.popup_en: cxd5! White exchanges in the center and creates an isolated queen's pawn (IQP), shifting the pawn-structure lesson toward the middlegame and endgame.
moves.popup:
cxd5！兑换！形成孤立兵结构IQP
兵链课题从中局转入残局！

moves.popup_en: ...c5 attacks the base of White's d4-pawn structure.
h3 prevents ...Ng4 and stabilizes White's kingside.
Nfe4! The knight from f6 jumps to e4, attacks Bd3, and contests the center.
moves.popup:
Nfe4！f6马跳入e4！
直接攻击白方Bd3，争夺中心

moves.popup_en: Bxe7! White exchanges the bishop to reduce Black's active piece.
moves.popup: Bxe7！白方主动换象，消除黑方主动性

moves.popup_en: ...Qxe7 recaptures while keeping the queen active.
Rc1 places White's rook on the c-file to contest it.
moves.popup: Rc1！白车占c线，争夺c线控制权

moves.popup_en: ...Rac8 brings Black's a8-rook to the c-file. The fight for the file is on.
moves.popup: Rac8！黑方a8车占c线，c线争夺激烈

moves.popup_en: Nd4! White's knight occupies a key central square, turning the space in front of the isolated pawn into a strong outpost.
moves.popup:
Nd4！白马强占d4中心要点！
IQP前沿格变为白方马的据点

moves.popup_en: ...g6 reinforces Black's kingside and discourages an attack.
moves.popup: g6！黑方巩固王翼，防止白方攻击

moves.popup_en: Be2 retreats the bishop and clears the way for f4.
...h5 expands on the kingside and tries to gain space.
moves.popup: h5！黑方王翼扩张，试图争夺空间

moves.popup_en: f4! White advances on the kingside, combining with Nd4 to increase the pressure. The pawn structure remains a source of active play.
moves.popup:
f4！白方王翼推进！
与Nd4形成强大压制，兵链威力再现

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 retreats the knight to defend while keeping counterplay options.
moves.popup: Nf6！黑马撤回f6，兼顾防守与反击

moves.popup_en: Bd3! White redeploys the bishop, pointing toward h7.
moves.popup: Bd3！白象再部署，对角线指向h7

moves.popup_en: ...Nxd3 exchanges Black's knight for the bishop and removes the diagonal pressure.
moves.popup: Nxd3！黑方换掉白象，避免对角线压力

moves.popup_en: Qxd3 centralizes White's queen on the d-file and coordinates with Nd4. White keeps the positional advantage.
moves.popup:
Qxd3！白后中心化！
控制d3-h7对角线，配合Nd4
白方位置优势明显！
